title: Surreal Psychedelic Dreamscape
description: A large white stylized human head with an open mouth and visible pink brain dominates the left side, with blue smoke-like forms containing women's faces flowing from it. To the right stands a golden retro robot, a green alien in a trash can, and a green-skinned woman with orange hair, all set against a vibrant cityscape under a large yellow sun with green laser beams and rain.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting featuring a giant white stylized human head in profile with exposed pink brain and blue swirling energy flowing out containing multiple women's faces. A golden retro robot walks in the midground, a small green alien sits inside a metal trash can, and a green-skinned woman with long orange hair stands nearby. Vibrant city skyline in background under a giant yellow sun emitting green beams and red light streaks, rain falling from dark clouds, large decorative flowers in foreground, highly detailed symbolic composition with bold outlines.
